description: Baker's-Dozen order console: the 6-tool JSON-schema registry for the flume-schema agent platform. Every tool has a name, a description, an idempotency flag and a JSON-schema parameter contract. Tools labelled idempotent may be re-executed freely; tools not labelled idempotent must never be executed twice with identical arguments.

tools.name: search_menu
tools.description: Search the menu by name substring; returns matching items ordered by item_id. Idempotent: safe to call repeatedly.

tools.name: get_stock
tools.description: Look up the current stock, price and name of an item. Idempotent: safe to call repeatedly; returns live stock.

tools.name: place_order
tools.description: Place an order for qty units of an item. Decrements stock and creates an order. NOT idempotent: a repeated call with the same arguments must not execute again.

tools.name: charge_card
tools.description: Charge an order's total to the customer's card. May be briefly unavailable (retryable transient error). NOT idempotent: a repeated call with the same arguments must not execute again.

tools.name: send_notification
tools.description: Send a text notification to a recipient. NOT idempotent: a repeated call with the same arguments must not execute again.

tools.name: finalize_order
tools.description: Mark one or more placed orders as finalized. NOT idempotent: a repeated call with the same arguments must not execute again.
